title: Counter-Selector Wave 30: public handoff positive controls
purpose: Calibrate the handoff gate against two publicly inspectable transitions: a named person-to-person technical-governance role transfer and a service-provider operational-authority rotation followed by successor execution. Preserve component-level positives without treating authority transfer as a complete state package or candidate promotion.

complete_direct_handoff_requires: authority, credentials, dependencies, and open decisions inventoried
rollback, refusal, and safe-decline conditions preserved
successor action observed from the transferred state
continuity observed without hidden focal-person state

source_records.artifact_scope: Shows the project executing a post-transition release cycle with the incoming lead included in the active coordination surface.

counterevidence: The selecting body, not the outgoing person alone, chose the incoming lead.
No public credential, signing-key, dependency, or open-decision inventory was located.
Current role occupancy is not a recipient-acknowledged state package.
Post-transition release activity does not prove that it arose from a complete outgoing handoff.
The outgoing person remains a core maintainer, so continuity may still depend on retained participation.
falsifiers: evidence that no core-maintainer vote occurred
evidence that the incoming person never occupied the lead role
evidence that the outgoing person retained exclusive lead authority after the announced transition
a public complete state package and recipient acknowledgment that would justify a stronger handoff state

source_records.title: Risk Stewards - PT Parameter Changes on Aave V3 - 2026-06-12
source_records.artifact_scope: Records manual continuation of the prior methodology and confirms execution of the listed parameter changes.

counterevidence: The offboarding plan promised handoff materials, but the complete public package was not acquired.
Historical risk data, automation pipelines, oracle infrastructure, and tacit operating context were not shown to transfer completely.
Manual successor execution demonstrates continuity but not equivalence to the former automated system.
Key rotation transfers permission, not necessarily knowledge, models, dependencies, or rollback state.
The transition is distributed across providers and DAO machinery rather than attributable to one person.
falsifiers: evidence that the keys were not rotated
evidence that the outgoing provider remained permissioned after the stated rotation
evidence that successor risk actions were not executed
a public complete handoff package and recipient acknowledgment that would justify a stronger state

next_action: Use these controls to score future handoff claims component by component; acquire public state-package, recipient-acknowledgment, dependency-inventory, rollback, and successor-operation receipts without contacting source subjects.
